title: NexusDaemonMomentDirectiveResponse
description: Response for POST /v1/daemon/moment-directive (V1.151 P0 DF-76; DR-63 schema-tightening). Formalizes the live wire shape the handler already emits: `set`/`show` return the full directive row (all 15 fields, incl. body — the author surface, NOT the inspector packet; AC-I3 governs only the packet's status-only `moment_directive` section), and `show` with no effective directive / `clear` return `{}`. Both branches are honest payloads today, so both are valid responses; the schema adds the typed contract without any wire change (additive only).

oneOf.title: NexusDaemonMomentDirectiveResponseDirective
oneOf.description: The active directive row (set, or show with an effective directive). Mirrors `nexus_local_db::moment_directive::MomentDirectiveRow` 1:1 — the nullable fields serialize as explicit JSON null (never omitted), matching the row's `serde::Serialize` output.

scope_kind.description: Scope kind of the directive: work | world.

scope_id.description: Work id (scope_kind=work) or world id (scope_kind=world) the directive is scoped to. For an inherited World override on a Work show, names the inherited source.

body.description: Author instruction text (author surface — this route carries the body by design; the inspector packet's `moment_directive` section is status-only per AC-I3).

insert_depth.description: Placement within the directive region: head | mid | tail.

ttl_kind.description: TTL kind: count down by assembling generations or chapter advances.

ttl_remaining.description: Remaining TTL count (decremented in place; 0 ⇒ expired, so an active row always carries >= 1).

clear_on_scene_change.description: Clear when the focused moment anchor changes between assembles.

last_focused_event_id.description: Last focused `MomentRequest.event_id` seen at an injecting assemble (scene-change signal). Null until the first injection.

updated_at.description: Unix epoch millis of the last lifecycle write.

expires_at.description: Unix epoch millis when soft-deleted (TTL-0 / scene-clear / manual clear). Null while active.

replaced_by.description: New directive id when `--replace` superseded this row. Null otherwise.

oneOf.title: NexusDaemonMomentDirectiveResponseEmpty
oneOf.description: No directive: `show` with no effective directive for the scope, or a successful `clear`. An empty object `{}` — the pre-schema wire behavior, unchanged.
